metadata.selection_policy: top conjecture-strategy alignment with coherence-aware bridge matching

strategy_family_catalog.invariant-lift-through-intermediate-obje: Introduce a conjectured intermediate object or invariant, prove that the source regime induces it, then force the target consequence through that invariant.
strategy_family_catalog.spectral-calculus-realization: Use spectral theorem or functional calculus data to realize the hidden bridge object, then exponentiate or reconstruct the target dynamics from that representation.
strategy_family_catalog.generator-recovery-from-unitary-orbits: Recover the infinitesimal generator from strongly continuous orbit data, prove the required domain and closure properties, then identify the target operator.
strategy_family_catalog.domain-core-self-adjointness: Build a dense core on which the hidden operator is well-defined, prove symmetry or closure there, and upgrade the core data to self-adjointness.
strategy_family_catalog.measure-construction-from-positive-funct: Recover the hidden measure object from positivity on the function space, then prove that the resulting set function is regular and uniquely represents the target functional.
strategy_family_catalog.regularity-via-compact-open-approximatio: Use compact-open approximation, Urysohn-type separation, and regularity reconstruction to turn topological control into a unique representing measure.
strategy_family_catalog.integration-duality-decomposition: Express the target functional through integration against a regular measure, then extend to signed or complex duality using Jordan decomposition or total variation control.
strategy_family_catalog.affine-averaging-to-fixed-point: Use affine orbit averages inside the compact convex set, extract a limiting witness by compactness, and prove that the limit is a fixed point for the single map.
strategy_family_catalog.invariant-fixed-point-subset-reduction: Construct the fixed-point subset of one map, prove it is nonempty compact convex and preserved by commuting maps, then recurse on the reduced invariant subset.
strategy_family_catalog.finite-intersection-compactness-lift: Show every finite commuting subfamily has a common fixed point, package these as nonempty compact sets, and use finite intersection plus compactness to obtain a point fixed by the whole family.
strategy_family_catalog.surrogate-reduction-transfer: Define a surrogate object or promise problem, reduce the source statement into it, and transfer the required consequence through the surrogate interface.
strategy_family_catalog.barrier-escape-reencoding: Re-encode the conjectured bridge concept in a representation that preserves the intended invariant while sidestepping the currently dominant barrier family.
strategy_family_catalog.contradiction-via-collapse-or-separation: Assume the conjectured bridge fails or the target consequence does not hold, then derive a forbidden collapse or contradiction with a known separation profile.
strategy_family_catalog.bootstrapped-derandomization-transfer: Use a derandomization or pseudorandomness-style object as the bridge, then bootstrap it into a lower-bound or separation consequence.
strategy_family_catalog.case-split-regime-transfer: Partition the argument by regime, model, or threshold case, prove each branch against the same bridge concept, and reassemble the target consequence.
